reason: I already pay for Cursor and it works; adding a daemon, adapters, and MCP servers just to share sessions across agents I'm not even running is more setup than it's worth.
objection: Setup looks complex — daemon, adapters, MCP servers — and I don't want another tool when Cursor already does what I need.
would_change_my_mind: A one-command install that drops into my existing Cursor setup with zero daemon babysitting, or my team actually running 3+ agents and hitting real context-silo pain.
